source: recorded_plan worlds at offset +1; same 53 IID and 53 OOD test IDs as G5/G7 predecessor
predictor_dev: 27 recorded_plan dev worlds; threshold/model selection only
predictor_test: 53 locked IID and 53 locked template OOD worlds
prediction_unit: a currently successful pure-latent state at step k=1..4; label is failure at k+1
geometry: masked-mean pooled metrics, position-aligned shared-active-token metrics, and token cosine-Gram RMS
decoder_nll: teacher-forced gold target sequence mean per-token negative log likelihood
decoder_entropy_margin: free-running greedy decoder scores on generated tokens, through first EOS
jacobian: exact affine editor J=I+UV on active tokens; global spectral norm by fixed 80-step power iteration, state-dependent JVP gain along edit residual
predictors: single-feature AUROC and fixed-C class-balanced logistic models with train-only preprocessing; dev-selected threshold
